verdict.rationale: Self-hosting relay or rendezvous infrastructure is a fair question for a remote-desktop product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack describes an on-premises server, a self-hosted relay, or routing session traffic through customer-run infrastructure. The CLI, REST API, and custom-client configuration items cover deployment and account management, not where session traffic is relayed.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can self-host the rendezvous or relay infrastructure so session traffic stays on infrastructure I run
